messages:
devin: Quick check - who's bringing consoles for a lunchtime LAN tomorrow? I can bring a Switch + dock and a charger.

sophia: I'll bring my PS4 controller and snacks. Also down for some Jackbox after if y'all are into that. :popcorn:

jim: Depends on how long it runs. I can slip away at 12:30. Also volunteering as tournament referee if needed :joy:

maria: I have a spare HDMI cable and a small power strip in case we need more outlets.

alex: I only have a Switch Lite, but happy to play local rounds on handheld.

devin: Switch Lite totally fine. Plan: set up in Conf B near the windows, aim for 11:50 setup, 12:10 start. Bracket style, double elim if we get >8.

tara: @devin can you tag @facilities to make sure Conf B isn't booked? I can check calendar but wanted to flag.

nate: Confirmed Conf B is free at that time. Also we have a rolling chair available if someone forgets one :chair:

sophia: Signup (quick):
```
1) Devin - Switch + dock
2) Sophia - PS4 controller + snacks
3) Jim - ref + small prize (Steam card)
4) Maria - HDMI + power strip
5) Alex - Switch Lite
6) Tara - extra JoyCon
``` 

devin: Perfect. If anyone needs adapters (USB-C to HDMI) shout here. I'll bring a microSD for replay saves if someone wants highlights.

jim: Can someone also bring disinfectant wipes for controllers? Shared gear + lunch = germ city. :sweat_smile:

maria: On it.

alex: After Smash, Rocket League on Steam? 2v2 casuals.

sophia: I'm in for Rocket League spectating/cheering duties.

tara: Great! See everyone tomorrow. I'll bring the extra JoyCon batteries. :battery:

devin: Thanks team, posting a reminder in the morning. GLHF :video_game:
